title: Commission enhances energy efficiency and sustainability of data centres in the EU
summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 21 Sep 2026 The European Commission proposed today a common rating scheme for data centres aimed at increasing transparency on their energy use and supporting their sustainable integration into Europe's energy system.
